title: Recording: Wake Up by Ringo Starr | 1980
content:
Devonshire Sound Studios, Los Angeles
Producer: Stephen Stills
Engineers: Stanley Johnston, Steve Gursky

Ringo Starr continued recording the outtake song ‘Wake Up’ on 6 September 1980.

The song was written by Starr. This was the third recording session for it, and although final overdubs were added in December 1980 and early 1981, it was left off his eighth studio album, Stop And Smell The Roses.
